checks.evidence: apps/web/server/api/windows.ts:71 and compare.ts:63 select status solely from file presence. Their unconditional 501 branches at windows.ts:78 and compare.ts:70 never check whether the requested IDs exist.

checks.evidence: unavailable.test.ts:86-107 requests the routes, parses each response, permits only the numeric status field, and rejects result-related keys. apps/web/vitest.config.ts:8 includes this test. This verifies meaningful test coverage by reading; the test was not executed.

findings.claim: Preserve the required 404 response for unknown window and comparison IDs. Both handlers currently return 501 whenever any source file exists, regardless of the requested IDs.
findings.evidence: windows.ts:71-80 never looks up id; compare.ts:63-73 similarly ignores a and b when selecting 501. By inspection, a bundle listing only comparisons/known.json makes /compare?a=missing&b=other return 501, and listing targets.json makes /windows/missing return 501. windows.test.ts:56-68 and compare.test.ts:55-67 pin this blanket behavior instead of testing the criterion's unknown-ID 404 rule.
